title: ADVANCED HEAT TRANSFER
description: Application of analytical techniques to the solution of multidimensional steady and transient problems in heat conduction and convection. Lumped, integral, and differential formulations. Topics include use of sources and sinks, laminar/turbulent forced convection, and natural convection in internal and external geometries.
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: MECE E3311 Corequisites: MECE E6100
